A secluded spot to escape the madness of urban living. Enjoy a pure nature reset in a modern and comfy house where the ocean meets land. The house is recently built in architect designed Scandinavian minimalist style. 
Experience 360 degree view over the sea and the mountains.
Two bedrooms with private bathrooms and separate terrace, fully equipped kitchen/dining room, laundry area, on-site parking. 
Indulge yourself with northern lights dancing across the sky, while you are relaxing in the bed

The space
Between the house and the horizon there is only the ocean. I've chosen to locate my house at the limits of the village to enjoy solitude, tranquility and fully relax. For photo enthusiasts - a perfect shooting spot with minimum of light pollution.

My name is Olga and you are welcome as a guest in my dream-house in Lofoten. Sharing-concept has been the main beacon in planning of the house. Your part of the house is facing the sun and aurora-sky. I live in the second part of the house. The harsh weather conditions (strong winds and heavy rain) there is a communication door between Your and my space. Each part is fully independent.
 
At home I feel safe, warm and comfy. The house has already standed against some heavy storms. It`s a place I find peace and relaxation together with my loved friends and family. The endless ocean panorama, the sound of waves and birds bring the balance and tranquility.

As a guest in my house you will find your beds prepared with bed linen and towels. You will sleep as a baby here.
Yoga lovers will find a set of yoga/meditation equipment. When you choose my house for your holiday accommodation, you contribute to keep my dream house construction on :-)

Guest access
check in with a door code

Other things to note
The spot is quite windy! for your own and the house safety, please hold all the doors while opening and never leave the door unattended while open.
I live on the second part of the house so we share both the view and the parking place. The harsh weather and safety of both of us require a direct connection through a corridor inside the house.

Like something out of a movie or an interior design magazine. Right on the beach, and the view is to die for (we did that for hours). The decor is stylish but also very cozy, and the kitchen is well equipped. My favorite appliance was the boot dryer!
Olga is great – we were on the same page right away, and she helped us a lot with planning tours and with insider tips. All in all, it was a fantastic vacation in Lofoten. Unfortunately, it was too short, but we'll be back for sure.

Where you’ll be
Flakstad, Nordland, Norway
In the closes vicinity you`ll find both a pristine nature, hiking paths and the ocean with bird colonies as well as all necessary facilites like a supermarket, a bus stop, cafe & restaurant, gasoline station and water sport activity center.
The popular and delightful Ramberg beach is just 5 min walking. The ocean front is 30 m right in front of the house !
